seasonseries.title: Nashville SC vs. Sporting Kansas City

keyEvents.text: Goal! Nashville SC 1, Sporting Kansas City 0. Hany Mukhtar (Nashville SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Andy Nájar with a cross.
Goal! Nashville SC 2, Sporting Kansas City 0. Sam Surridge (Nashville SC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Hany Mukhtar.

Goal! Nashville SC 3, Sporting Kansas City 0. Andy Nájar (Nashville SC) header from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Cristian Espinoza with a cross following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Maxwell Woledzi (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Jacob Bartlett replaces Zorhan Bassong.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Calvin Harris replaces André Luiz.
Second Half begins Nashville SC 3, Sporting Kansas City 0.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Taylor Calheira replaces Seymour Reid.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Daniel Lovitz replaces Andy Nájar.
